title: Uhambo Lomphefumulo Owamukelwe
intro: Ngesikhathi lapho izimiso zomphakathi zazibusa khona, umuntu ohlukile wabhekana noshintsho olukhulu emndenini obusisiwe. Indaba yabo, ephawulwe ngesibopho sothando kanye nesinqumo saphezulu, ibonisa ukwephulwa kwamasiko amadala kanye nokumiswa kwezimiso ezintsha nezilungile. Le ndaba igcizelela ukubaluleka kweqiniso kunemithetho kanye nokuhlakanipha okusekelwe emithethweni ka-Allah.
clues: Ngangiyisiboshwa, kodwa ngelungiselelo likaNkulunkulu, ngathola ikhaya elisha nomndeni.
Ngangithandwa kakhulu kangangokuthi lapho nginikwa ukukhetha phakathi komndeni wami wemvelo nomnakekeli wami wokutholwa, ngakhetha ukuhlala nowakamuva.
Igama lami lalihlotshaniswa nomnakekeli wami wokutholwa, umkhuba owawuvamile emphakathini wakithi.
Ngingumngane kuphela woMprofethi wokugcina ogama lakhe likhulunywa ngokucacile ngu-Allah e-Quran.
Ngashada nowesifazane ohloniphekile owayengumzala woMprofethi, kodwa umshado wethu awuzange uhlale isikhathi eside.
Ngemva kwesehlukaniso sami, u-Allah uqobo lwakhe wanquma ukuthi umkami wangaphambili uzoshada noMprofethi, ngaleyo ndlela echitha isiko lasendulo mayelana nokutholwa komntwana.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
